# FamilyOS

> FamilyOS is a shared operating system for African families to manage contributions, school fees, projects, farming, meetings, assets, and shared records.

## Primary Pages
- Home: https://familyoshq.com/
- Blog: https://familyoshq.com/blog/

## Access Notes
- https://familyoshq.com/app/ is the sign-in and application entry point. It is not a public knowledge page.
- Public informational content is published on the homepage and blog.
